items.title: Unreal Engine 5.9 Preview Is Out & It Was Built With AI
items.excerpt: Epic's UE 5.9 Preview ships AI workflow enhancements (agent tools, Unreal Canvas generation) plus web platform, rendering and animation updates; Epic says the preview itself was built largely with AI.
items.rationale: New engine release with agent tools and Unreal Canvas generation — directly changes how UE teams work; games owns this story per cross-section assignment.

items.title: House House clarifies use of AI tools in Big Walk's "final stage of development"
items.excerpt: House House issued a statement on AI tool use in Big Walk after a group of 2027 IGF jurors said they would decline to vote for games that used generative AI during development.
items.rationale: Studio's official statement plus IGF juror stance sets a concrete awards-eligibility line on gen-AI use; industry-trade source carries both halves.

items.title: ゲーム日本語化ツール「PCOT」次のアプデで開発終了へ。AIの進化で“セルフ直接日本語化”の未来が見えたため
items.excerpt: Solo developer nurupo is ending the long-running game translation-assist tool PCOT after its next update, saying AI has made players' self-service direct Japanese localization the future.
items.rationale: A long-standing fan-localization tool retiring because AI replaced its job — concrete signal on player-side localization.

items.title: Educational game dev program cancelled because students were submitting games made entirely with AI
items.excerpt: An educational game-development program was cancelled because growing generative-AI use made it 'harder to judge what students made themselves.'
items.rationale: New event showing AI breaking game-dev education assessment — fresh angle distinct from storefront slop stories.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 Builds Playable Gears of War: E-Day Clone From Three-Line Prompt
items.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 built a playable Unreal Engine Gears of War clone from a three-line prompt, but the project consumed about 8.5 billion tokens.
items.rationale: Concrete capability-and-cost datapoint for agentic game building in Unreal (8.5B tokens, ~$15k) — useful calibration for teams.
